answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus acts as a robust barrier against Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital to participate in network validation. Like a terrace built to prevent erosion, staked tokens create a high entry cost, ensuring that creating new fake identities remains economically irrational. Much like a comet traversing space, an attacker must burn immense financial resources to gain influence, ensuring the network reaches a secure dawn where honest agents maintain governance dominance over malicious actors.
